scope: Local main-branch integration and validation; not a new editorial checkpoint, final browser acceptance, CI or publication.
decisions: Adopt the six upstream modal/result component and test files. Only two occurrences of the Close label in PlannerOverlay comments use English so the staged i18n heuristic does not flag them as new display text.
Keep the complete five-language Codex CLI/cloud packs and matching hero/diagram assets at their original slugs; no duplicate lessons.
Keep the union of shared code language labels, including toml, sh, shell and csv; select Claude by its series identifier and assert its current 96 entries/16 groups/12 paths.

Align the Codex code-block regression with the established shared API LF-normalization contract. Markup, indentation and terminal newline remain exact; the shared rich-block tests also verify this behavior.
Use the publication UTC clock for expired fixtures, avoiding local-date failures after midnight in Asia/Taipei.
Adopt upstream completed modal and AI-batch task records; keep independent earlier diagnostics under their original evidence files.

content_preservation.serialization_note: Git checkout changed the two selected JSON files from CRLF to LF. Restoring only their original serialization newlines reproduced the exact pre-merge hashes; JSON document values did not change.

resolved_check_failures: Initial post-merge API run: 3 failed / 35 passed / 17 PostgreSQL skips in 92.29s. One contradicted the shared code newline contract and two fixtures used local rather than publication UTC dates.
The staged i18n check first flagged the inherited Chinese Close text in comments; English-only comments resolved it without changing visible copy or runtime behavior.

The completion command left identical task bodies in open and done. Removed only the obsolete open copy after verifying the archived body; the final check validates 451 tasks. The underlying tool issue is already tracked in 2026-09-14-investigate-windows-task-archive-leftover-open.
manual_source_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source with CRLF normalized to LF, matching Git text storage. The current test_codex_learning.py checkout has mixed newlines (raw SHA-256 653364a42e250cd56717a2a0e53e0fc40743bf97e15c8f082bf0d777542854f2); its LF hash matches the recorded source and Git reports no code diff.
limits: Earlier API/modal evidence describes its named pre-merge source, not this new source or dependency set.
PostgreSQL integration tests were explicitly disabled; SQLite results are not PostgreSQL proof.
Existing upstream raw logs and intentional CSV/help whitespace were retained; no blanket whitespace rewrite was performed.
Article/hub edit and final-preview auto-review restrictions remain; no rejected operation was retried, and no PR/import/publication/deployment occurred.
The completed full suite validates be815096 locally; it is one integration run, not three consecutive final runs or a remote CI result.
